title: Give to The Winds Thy Fears
lyrics_original: Give to the winds thy fears;
God hears thy sighs and counts thy tears,
God shall lift up thy head.
Through waves and clouds and storms
Wait thou His time, so shall this night
Cast off the weight, let fear depart,
When fully He the work hath wrought,
So shalt thou, wondering, own His way,
How wise, how strong His hand.
Our hearts are known to Thee:
O lift Thou up the sinking hand,
Let us, in life, in death,
And publish with our latest breath
author_english: Paul Gerhardt (1653), translated by John Wesley

bible_verses.english: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, my heart often grows weary beneath the weight of fear and uncertainty. Forgive me for holding so tightly to worries You have asked me to cast upon You. Soften my heart to wait patiently for Your timing, trusting that You hear every quiet cry. Lift my head today, Jesus, and fill my spirit with the hopeful assurance that Your joy is coming. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When life feels overwhelming, it is easy to hold tightly to our anxieties and doubts. Yet this classic hymn gently invites us to release our heavy burdens into the care of a loving God who counts every tear and sees every sigh. Even in the deepest storms, the Lord is faithfully clearing a path forward and preparing a bright dawn for our weary hearts. Today, let us surrender our fears to Him, trusting that His perfect timing will turn our darkest night into lasting joy.
